game.name: Bionic Commando (2009)(Japan)
game.desc: The first sequel to the popular NES title, Bionic Commando sees the return of Nathan "R.A.D." Spencer. Times are tough for Spencer: five years after fighting the Imperials, the government betrays him and sentences him to death for a crime he didn't commit. On the day of the execution, terrorists detonate an experimental charge in Ascension City. This triggers a massive earthquake and wipes out the population. The area is in ruins and the FSA has only one option: attack. It's the perfect job for a Bionic Commando. Bionic Commando takes the original 2D swing shooter concept into 3D in an urban environment with skyscrapers, suspension bridges, monorails. Climb, jump and use all the progression tactics to achieve your goals.
